status_note: The 9-line covered projection byte-matches Ghidra 12.0.4's PrintC warning-comment emission path: docFunction:2650 setupFunctionList through the arch commentdb, emitCommentFuncHeader's header_basic drain with the C-style delimiters and the trailing extralinebreak line, emitBlockBasic's per-block setupBlockList window + per-statement emitCommentGroup landmarks + the NULL tail drain, and emitLineComment's absolute indent override (endl + exactly `indent` spaces, EmitNoMarkup::tagLine(int4) prettyprint.hh:557). Overall remains MISMATCH for the pipeline-level integration: the full curl E2E confirmation of the 16 '/* WARNING: Subroutine does not return */' statements is left to the root merge batch, and Rugra's doc_function still collapses the header/signature separator to a single line break (EmitNoMarkup newline-suppression convention, documented at the cc:2653 call site).

rugra_source.rust_overlay: Archive Rugra base 9d0674c887aae01213490adb356933bef2853278 and overlay only the owned src/printc.rs candidate before the isolated offline build

architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5; byte addressed
architecture.emitter: C++ side swaps PrintC's default EmitPrettyPrint (printlanguage.cc:69) for a bare EmitNoMarkup inside the fixture subclass, matching the Rust comparand's emitter class so the bytes isolate the printc comment protocol from the unported pretty-printer fill

compiler_spec.calling_convention: empty input/output records; no effects, symbols, or injections

analysis_options.api: Direct production PrintC protocol steps (setup_function_comments / emit_comment_func_header / setup_block_comment_list / emit_comment_group) over Funcdata::warning and Funcdata::warningHeader databases; no Action or Rule pipeline
analysis_options.funcdata: Three synthetic Funcdata runs (clean, noreturn, multi); BlockBasic graphs whose reverse-post-order indexes come from the production BlockGraph::findSpanningTree port on both sides; ops created and inserted in one fixed mirrored order (creation order fixes SeqNum::uniq and the order field, insertion order fixes the BlockBasic order ladder)
analysis_options.ir: Ops carry addresses only; no Varnodes, inputs, or outputs. C++ block ranges use Funcdata::setBasicBlockRange with end == the last op's address; Rugra blocks carry start_addr == first-op address (initial_range is only set by the production followFlow path), so every fixture comment sits at its block's first-op address where both contains() projections agree
analysis_options.normalization: None. The emitted projection is the raw EmitNoMarkup byte stream per case (len + <<< >>> delimited body); no ID, order, or state normalization
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and walks are deterministic

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(cases, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.setup: Funcdata fad=0x8000, one BlockBasic [0x8000,0x8004] with ops X@0x8000 Y@0x8004, empty comment database (arch commentdb installed, no warning calls)
cases.protocol: setup_function_comments; emit_comment_func_header; per block: setup_block_comment_list + one emit_comment_group landmark per op + emit_comment_group(None)
cases.expect: zero emitted bytes (no header comment, no statement comments, no tail)

cases.setup: Funcdata fad=0x9000, blocks bb0 [0x9000,0x9006] ops P Q, bb1 [0x9008,0x900a] ops call@0x9008 S@0x900a, edge bb0->bb1; Funcdata::warning("Subroutine does not return", call->getAddr()) through the arch commentdb channel (flow.cc:646 -> funcdata.cc:119)
cases.expect: comment positioned at (bb1, call order); the header window is empty (warning is instr-level); the first landmark of bb1 emits endl + exactly 20 spaces (line_commentindent override) + '/* WARNING: Subroutine does not return */'; bb0 and the tail drain nothing

cases.setup: Funcdata fad=0xa000, blocks bb0 [0xa000,0xa006] ops A B, bb1 [0xa008,0xa00a] ops call1@0xa008 S, bb2 [0xa00c,0xa00e] ops call2@0xa00c F, chain edges; Funcdata::warningHeader("Unknown calling convention -- yet parameter storage is locked") + Funcdata::warning at call1 and call2 addresses (distinct addresses survive addCommentNoDuplicate)
cases.protocol: same as clean, blocks in address order
cases.expect: header_basic drain emits endl + 0 spaces + '/* WARNING: Unknown calling convention -- yet parameter storage is locked */' then the extralinebreak endl; each call block's first landmark emits endl + 20 spaces + '/* WARNING: Subroutine does not return */'

observation_schema.format: 9 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one banner, then one case=...|len=N|emit=<<<...>>> record per case (the emission body may span lines; >>> terminates it)
observation_schema.placement_decisions: clean discriminates the empty-database no-op; noreturn discriminates findPosition's op-lower-bound placement at the call op and the instr_comment_type mask (the warning does NOT appear in the header window); multi discriminates the header_basic placement of warningheader@fad plus two distinct-address no-duplicate warnings at their call blocks
observation_schema.emission_bytes: the exact '/* ' + text + ' */' delimiter form, the absolute indent override (20 spaces for instr comments, 0 for the header), the unconditional endl of EmitNoMarkup::tagLine(indent) (including the blank line between the header comment and the first instr comment produced by the extralinebreak tagLine + the comment's leading endl), and the 62/202-byte lengths

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: Funcdata::warning/warningHeader write through the shared glb->commentdb / arch.commentdb reference (not a copy); setup_function_comments reads that same database; emit_comment_group marks each drained Comment emitted=true in the sorter state
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: docFunction:2650 walks the database range for the function entry address in (addr, uniq) order; the statement loop walks bb->beginOp() insertion order; emitCommentFuncHeader drains setupHeader(header_basic) then header_unplaced only under option_unplaced (false here)
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: Subsort.pos starts at 0 once per setupFunctionList and increments only for placed comments; line_commentindent (20) substitutes for every negative indent; extralinebreak starts false and latches on the first header emission
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: Subsort orders by signed int4 index (-1 header keys before block indexes), then uint4 order, then uint4 pos; setupBlockList bounds [lower_bound((bl,0,0)), upper_bound((bl,MAX,MAX))]; setupOpList upper_bound((bl,op order,MAX)); the instr/head type masks (user2|warning / header|warningheader) gate only at consumption
